record.context_brief: Lower bounds for cubic and higher moments
record.original_question: Soundararajan proved the lower bound I3(T) >= (20.26 a3 / 9!) (1 + o(1)) T (log T)^9 for sufficiently large T. Improve the constant 20.26, ideally all the way to the conjecturally best value 42, and likewise improve the corresponding lower-bound constants for Ik(T) when k > 3.

evidence.quote: Soundararajan [65] proved the following lower bound for I3 (T ): I3 (T ) >= 20.26 a3 / 9! (1 + o(1)) T (log T )^9, for T sufficiently large. Improve the value of 20.26. The best possible result would be 42. (Likewise improve the lower bounds for Ik (T ) for k > 3.)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an integer $k\ge 1$ and $T>0$, define the $2k$-th moment of the Riemann zeta function on the critical line by
$$I_k(T)\;=\;\int_0^T \bigl|\zeta(\tfrac12+it)\bigr|^{2k}\,dt.$$
It is conjectured that
$$I_k(T)\;\sim\;\frac{a_k\,g_k}{(k^2)!}\,T(\log T)^{k^2}\qquad(T\to\infty),$$
where $a_k$ is the arithmetic factor
$$a_k\;=\;\prod_{p}\Bigl(1-\tfrac{1}{p}\Bigr)^{k^2}\sum_{m=0}^{\infty}\binom{k+m-1}{m}^{2}p^{-m},$$
and $g_k$ is a positive integer; in particular $g_1=1$, $g_2=2$, and Conrey--Ghosh conjectured $g_3=42$, while Conrey--Gonek conjectured $g_4=24024$.

It is known unconditionally that for $T$ sufficiently large,
$$I_3(T)\;\ge\;\frac{20.26\,a_3}{9!}\,(1+o(1))\,T(\log T)^9.$$

(a) Improve the constant $20.26$ in this lower bound for $I_3(T)$, ideally pushing it up to the conjecturally optimal value $42$.

(b) For each integer $k\ge 4$, establish an unconditional lower bound of the form
$$I_k(T)\;\ge\;\frac{C_k\,a_k}{(k^2)!}\,(1+o(1))\,T(\log T)^{k^2}$$
with the constant $C_k$ as large as possible, with the conjectural target $C_k=g_k$.
artifact.category_tag: moments of the Riemann zeta function
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of improving the constant remains open in the sense that the conjectural target ($g_3=42$, and $g_k$ for $k>3$) has not been reached unconditionally. However, partial progress has been made: Soundararajan's bound of $20.26$ has been improved, e.g. to $24.59$ (unpublished) and subsequently to $29.54$ via refinements of the lower-bounds method (Heap--Radziwiłł--Soundararajan and successors). The full conjectural constants remain unproven.

status_evidence.title: Lower bounds for moments of zeta and L-functions revisited
status_evidence.snippet: Refinements of the Heap-Radziwill-Soundararajan method give improved constants in lower bounds of the form I_k(T) >> T (log T)^{k^2}.
status_evidence.claim: The lower-bound constants in Soundararajan's method have been improved, but not to the conjectural values.

status_evidence.title: Moments of the Riemann zeta function (Soundararajan)
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes lower bounds of the form I_k(T) >> T(log T)^{k^2} with explicit constants for integer k, including the constant 20.26 for k=3.
status_evidence.claim: Source for the original 20.26 lower bound constant for I_3(T).
